title: Finite quasi-compact jointly surjective pullbacks detect module sheaf morphisms
statement: Let U be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and R a ring in the coefficient universe. Let (g_i : Z_i → U) be a finite family of quasi-compact scheme morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] whose images cover U. For fixed R-module sheaves F and G on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and a morphism φ : F → G, if every inverse-image morphism g_i^* φ is zero [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], then φ is zero. No weak-etaleness, Noetherianity, or compactness assumption on U is imposed. The empty family is allowed when U is empty.

proof.text: Apply the already proved adopted source declaration eq_zero_of_forall_upperStar_map_eq_zero. For each section of the target sheaf, the pullback adjunction units and naturality reduce detection of the value of φ to detection of a section. The preceding source theorem eq_zero_of_forall_unit_app_eq_zero proves that detection: local injectivity of sheafification and the filtered left Kan extension give pro-etale neighborhoods of every base-changed point on which the section vanishes. Quasi-compactness and finiteness combine these neighborhoods into a cover of the original object. Sheaf separatedness gives zero. Sheaf and module-map extensionality then give φ = 0. This records an existing complete source proof; no additional Lean theorem or unproved declaration is introduced.
